No environment type lookup or closed acceptance allowlist. The five named release types require manual release N and accounting N under preImportConsistency; conflicting Y values are rejected before build.

DspDescription.boundary: Explicit nonblank description; lookup-backed insert. Standard create can delete/reinsert the same-context supporting HOLD CODE/set0/application200 lookup. Disclose that maintenance without requiring independent shared-lookup absence or pre-import description/language/tag/setter-order proof; exported-value verification is optional follow-up when requested.

UserUpdateableFlag.boundary: Default Y only when omitted on create; explicit Y/N takes precedence. Reject supplied blank/null. Update omission preserves baseline.

UserReleaseableFlag.boundary: Explicit Y/N, subject to preImportConsistency. Create N requires supplied routing N and blank instruction/notification/reminder values. Derive those outcomes only for omitted fields; reject conflicting supplied values, including exact INCOMPLETE INVOICE. The five named release types prohibit manual Y on create.

PostableFlag.boundary: Default N only when omitted on create; explicit Y/N takes precedence subject to preImportConsistency. The skill rejects X and supplied blank/null. WaitBeforeNotifyDays.boundary: Optional nonnegative signed 64-bit integer. Create manual N requires blank days; reject supplied numbers, including zero.

ReminderDays.boundary: Optional nonnegative signed 64-bit integer; no ordering relation inferred. Create manual N requires blank days; reject supplied numbers, including zero.

InitiateWorkflowFlag.boundary: Optional Y/N/blank generally; create manual N requires routing N. Reject supplied Y or explicit clear when that rule applies; derive N only on omission. Final-row workflow validation also applies.

evidence: holds-definition-create-and-updates-v4: create normalization, deterministic full-row package validation and reconciliation, plus ten existing-row update fields including PostableFlag and DspDescription.

Create requires explicit key, type, description and manual-release flag. Omitted UserUpdateableFlag defaults to Y and omitted PostableFlag to N; supplied values must pass scalar and pre-import consistency rules. Create manual N or an eligible changed-to-N update requires routing N and blank instruction/days; reject supplied conflicts and derive only omitted outcomes. Same-N or omitted manual flags do not trigger the manual rule; final routing N independently clears all resolution options. Five named release types require manual N/accounting N on create. Applied defaults and derived omitted values remain separate from requests.

Independent create validation checks every candidate field and omitted optional blank, rejects existing keys and audit overrides, and protects baseline rows. Create cannot produce an exact automatic rollback.

Manual-release requested intent is separate from exact baseline-derived omitted values. Independent validation rederives consistency, every materialized value and the baseline binding; warnings or forged provenance cannot waive a conflict. Ordinary preview names requests and derivation separately. Other values and rows remain protected.

Existing-row update eligibility is enforced against the qualified baseline: five release types prohibit requested accounting or manual-release changes; other types require baseline UserUpdateableFlag=Y. Requested routing changes fail when either baseline manual-release or updateability is N. Requested nonblank notification-day, reminder-day or hold-instruction assignments fail when routing is N or blank; detail clears are allowed for exact N when baseline updateability permits. Baseline updateability N still blocks explicit detail changes. An eligible request to enable routing can include detail changes; omitted routing keeps its existing value. Requested inactive-date assignments/clears and description changes fail when baseline UserUpdateableFlag is exactly N, regardless of type. Preserved values, explicit no-ops, materialized source effects and create operations are outside these change restrictions; the final routing-N consistency rule still requires all resolution options blank. Baseline manual-release and updateability restrictions still apply. A retained blank or requested routing clear does not enable details; raw omitted CSV values are preserved. DspDescription is required lookup-backed text, distinct from ExternalDescription. Accounting and full-row lookup maintenance effects are disclosed, not prerequisites for accepted-input validation; reverse setup updates do not establish prior accounting-event, hidden lookup or all-language restoration.

A valid reverse package restores requested and collateral originals only when every requested reverse change passes the update restrictions against the current qualified readback. A restricted reverse stops with its diagnostic before publishing recovery artifacts. Staging does not bypass eligibility; any otherwise valid staged recovery requires exact intermediate readback, separate approval and no automatic submission.

Date input, serialized date cells, calendar-value preservation and raw-value evidence follow ora-resource/ora_input_validation.md#calendar-dates. Field end-dating remains an update, not a separate operation.

Input validation and source-effect disclosures do not imply a live result. Description persistence, language/tag assignments, deployed setter order and resulting saved values are not pre-import proof prerequisites. Exact artifact approval remains required. Routine post-import verification is not required for ordinary import; reconciliation is requested follow-up or a conditional failure, uncertain-outcome or recovery step.

Ordinary create requires fresh exact-task key absence, accepted inputs and a validated immutable artifact; no standalone shared-lookup absence gate applies. Standard supporting lookup delete/reinsert is disclosed without claiming the task export proves hidden absence. Normalize reports inputPreflightReady; valid candidates without unresolved warnings are eligibleForDataLoaderValidation; executionAuthorized remains false. Aggregate generation.readyForLiveE2E remains false only until controlled create-test retained-state cleanup prerequisites are approved. Fusion validates HoldType membership during import without an environment precheck.
